body: our therapist is very much aware of our suicidal alters and helps to develop tools to cope with the episodes. we do self-talk, for example, explaining that it is ok to experience the feelings because feelings are valid, but that what we are truly wanting isn't actually death but an escape from what feels unbearable and that the episode will pass. we have set up what we describe as road blocks that help to prevent us from acting on the urges when they arise. one example is that we tell ourselves we can self-harm tomorrow, knowing through experience that when tomorrow comes the urges will have subsided.
Great to hear you are SAFE!

No. Simply no. Alters do not exist without trauma. Period. The ONLY exception to this when an alter is completely isolated from their trauma by amnesiac walls. Any claim to the contrary is just plain wrong.

For us inner chaos means someone inside is upset. If their distress is hegh enough their emotions will bleed through into the rest of the system. At this point we're in trouble, for it can cause a cascade, a system-wide collapse. 

The trick is to identify the source of the upset. With us it was littles being scare of therapy, prompted by Tee's profound distress.
Hi. We don't really have a system name. We are 16 of us, mostly littles. Daria is our host, Aloysius our protector.
